sections.title: Audience
sections.content: Two regular Host people in London, plus one Hububb Pro sample. Regular Host is owners and operators who run their own rentals. Pro is a property-management company: other people's units, employees, roles. Pro is in design, not live. Do not sell autonomous hosting. Do not treat this file as product truth for what is shipping.

sections.title: Jobs to be done
content: Keep a listing earning without it becoming a second job.
Put longer stays on the same flats and the same calendar, without a second stack.
Operate a management company: staff on assigned units, owners who can see their own, a company view that is not one shared password.

sections.title: Pains
content: Evenings and the 10pm guest ping on a single flat.
Turnovers that eat the week even when the nights pay.
A PM business sitting on a shared Host login, with no roles and Sunday owner packs.

sections.title: Lifestyle
sections.content: The evenings host has a real job. The turnover-tired host wants months, not another weekend clean. The Pro owner hired people so he would not be the operating system, and still is, until they have their own place in the product.

sections.title: Archetypes
rows: The evenings host (Priya, 1 flat, full-time job)
One listing quietly became a second job
Airbnb connected. Next clean on the booking. She stays the owner. She is not on call.
Months in the diary, fewer keys
Short nights wear the flats and the week
List on Stay for free. Keep Airbnb. One calendar. Premium Host is not the price of entry.
The Pro PMC owner (James, management company, 2 employees)
Staff and owners on a shared Host login. Host is a workaround.
Pro is for the firm: teams, roles, owners, a company view. In design, not live. Not Host plus a price.
